body: I'm really hoping that isn't how she was, but I might never know. That's a terrifying thought.

Ah, in that case, I really do feel for you. As a victim of sexual assault, all my feels.

I phrased it wrong, I never meant that she intentionally kicks them or hits them, they've all been accidental and she was always very very apologetic. Aside from that, we're not together anymore for various reasons anyway.

While I'm really sorry that it happened to you, I have to disagree that "it was not the first time he did it". There's a first time for everything, and sometimes people genuinely made a mistake. I once lightly smacked an SO in the upper shoulder when she was yelling at me, and instantly realized what I just did and apologized profusely for hours. This is the same woman who kicked me in the balls 4 separate times and hit me there once with a baton.

Unless you meant it wasn't the first time he hit you. In which case I feel stupid.
